moves.name: Horizontal Swing
moves.desc: Quick sideways swing (KO 35); also reached from several combo/evade actions (26,32,39-41) (MV 30)

use.how: Extreme: Horizontal Swing button from neutral (action 39,40,41), or after Charge Lv1 / Lv2, first hit (k0:8), Charge Upswing (k0:200), action 47 (+1 more): Horizontal Swing button · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Horizontal Swing button from walking (action 0); also straight out of a charge hold (26)

moves.name: Smash 1
moves.desc: First vertical smash (KO 25); not in the Charge Attack Up list, unlike the charge Lv1 record 8 which has the same MV 52 (MV 52)

use.how: Extreme: Vertical Swing button from neutral (action 36,37,38,50), or after Horizontal Swing (k0:6), Charge Upswing (k0:200), action 47 (+1 more): Vertical Swing button · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Vertical Swing button from walking (Smash 1)

moves.name: Charge Lv1 / Lv2, first hit
moves.desc: Charge release: first hit of Lv1 and of Lv2 (both 52, KO 20); Charge Attack Up +4/+6 (MV 52)
moves.input: Hold Charge, release at Lv1 or Lv2

use.how: Extreme: Hold Charge, release at Lv1 or Lv2 from neutral (action 6,15,16,17,51,52), or after action 10: Vertical Swing button; after action 10: Horizontal Swing button · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Hold Charge, release at Lv1 or Lv2: first hit

moves.name: Charge Lv2, hit 2
moves.desc: Second hit of the Lv2 charge (upswing that can launch allies); +1/+2 raises it to 36/37 (MV 35)

use.how: Extreme: later hit of Charge Lv1 / Lv2, first hit (k0:8), in the same action 6,17,52: no input of its own · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Second hit of the Lv2 charge release (same action as record 8)

moves.name: Charge Lv3 stamp, hit 1
moves.desc: First hit (40) of the standing Lv3 charge, the Super Pound; Lv4 hit 1 is also 40 but is record 148 (KO 30) (MV 40)

use.how: Extreme: Hold Charge, release at Lv3 standing still (its own action 7; no link leads to it, so the class code starts it, e.g. from neutral) · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Hold Charge, release at Lv3 standing: stamp hit 1

moves.name: Charge Lv3 stamp, hit 2
moves.desc: Second hit (100, KO 60) of the Lv3 charge pound; Charge Attack Up +9/+14 (MV 100)

use.how: Extreme: later hit of Charge Lv3 stamp, hit 1 (k0:10), in the same action 7: no input of its own · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Second hit of the Lv3 stamp (same action as record 10)

moves.name: Rotation (spin charge), first hit
moves.desc: Earth-style spinning charge release (moving Lv3): first spin hit (KO 2); listed in the Earth calc only (MV 20)

use.how: Earth: hold Charge while moving, release: Rotation first hit · Heaven/Storm: Heaven/Storm release with the stick tilted goes to the Lv3 stamp (7), not the rotation

moves.name: Rotation, middle hit (A)
moves.desc: Spin hit 2-6 (10 each); two records share MV 10 and KO 2, so which is which (left or right swing?) is not known (MV 10)

use.how: Rotation middle hit A (same state function as record 12)

moves.name: Rotation, middle hit (B)
moves.desc: Spin hit 2-6 (10 each); the other record with MV 10 (slightly longer active window than record 13) (MV 10)

use.how: Rotation middle hit B

moves.name: Rotation, final hit
moves.desc: 7th and last spin hit (40, KO 2); the Charge Lv3 first hit (40) is record 10 (MV 40)

moves.name: Smash 3 (upswing)
moves.desc: Third vertical smash, big upswing finisher (KO 80); same MV 100 as the Baseball Swing (record 139, KO 50) (MV 100)

moves.desc: Second vertical smash (KO 25) (MV 38)

use.how: Extreme: after Smash 1 (k0:7), Horizontal Swing (k0:6): Vertical Swing button · Earth/Heaven/Storm: After Smash 1, press Vertical Swing again (Smash 2)

moves.name: Swipes (rapid swings), first hit

use.how: Extreme: after Swipes, repeating hit (k0:123), Swipes (rapid swings), first hit (k0:116): Vertical Swing button · Earth/Heaven/Storm: Swipes repeating hit: re-enters while a command is buffered
